description: This file is a documentation source for the 'Composite Input HAL Interface' in a software project. It details the interface specifications, capabilities, operation sequences, system context, and various implementation considerations for managing composite video input ports via a HAL layer. The content is structured as Markdown with embedded diagrams, YAML snippets, and comprehensive explanations.

classes.name: PlatformCapabilities
classes.description: Represents platform-wide feature flags and capabilities related to composite input ports.

classes.name: PortCapabilities
classes.description: Defines the capabilities of a specific composite input port, including supported properties, metrics support, and property metadata.

classes.name: PortStatus
classes.description: Represents the current status of a port, including connection, signal, and video mode information.

classes.name: Port
classes.description: Contains metadata about a port such as name and description.

classes.name: SignalStatus
classes.description: Enum representing the quality/status of the signal (NO_SIGNAL, UNSTABLE, STABLE, NOT_SUPPORTED).

classes.name: VideoResolution
classes.description: Provides details about the video resolution and format for a port, including standard type and interlaced info.

classes.name: PortMetrics
classes.description: Telemetry data for a port, including lock time, drops, uptime, etc.

classes.name: PropertyKVPair
classes.description: Key-value pair used for batch property retrieval; key is a string, value is a union holding different property types.

classes.name: PropertyMetadata
classes.description: Describes a property's characteristics such as type, whether read-only, and description.

methods.name: getPlatformCapabilities
methods.description: Retrieves the platform-wide capabilities and feature flags related to composite input ports.

methods.name: getPortIds
methods.description: Returns a list of available port IDs for enumerating composite input ports.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns an interface to control a specific input port by its ID.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Returns the capabilities of a specific port, including supported properties and metrics support.

methods.name: getPortInfo
methods.description: Provides metadata like name and description of a port.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Queries a specific property value by key (e.g., signal strength).

methods.name: registerTelemetryListener
methods.description: Registers a listener for telemetry updates.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Sets the port as active for video presentation, only if signal is stable.
